desc: Precompute `pre[k]` for all `k` from 0 to N, where `pre[k]` is the number of distinct elements in `A[0..k-1]`.
Precompute `suf[k]` for all `k` from 0 to N, where `suf[k]` is the number of distinct elements in `A[k..N-1]`.
Precompute `prev_occ[k]` for each index `k`, which is the index of the previous occurrence of `A[k]`, or -1 if none.
Initialize a segment tree of size N-1 (for indices 1 to N-2) with values `pre[i]` for each `i`. The segment tree supports range add and range max query.
Update the segment tree: add 1 to the range `[max(1, prev_occ[j]+1), min(j-1, N-2)]`. Note: if `prev_occ[j]+1 > j-1`, no update needed for the query range.
Query the maximum value in the segment tree for the range `[1, j-1]`.
